permission.noticeHelpLabel: Why can't I approve this here?
permission.noticeExplain: Codex and Claude only tell Agent Pets that they are waiting for permission and give no way to send a decision back, so it cannot be approved here. Only OpenCode can be approved directly from the pet bubble.

permission.settingsReminderOnly: Reminder only; answer in the original tool
permission.settingsRiskRules: Risk is judged conservatively: only read-only tools such as read and search count as low risk, every other tool is treated as high risk, and high-risk requests cannot be approved with the global shortcut.
permission.hotkeyUnavailable: The shortcut is taken by another app; use the buttons instead
permission.keyboardHint: Keyboard: N or Esc denies; hold Y for 0.6 s to allow
permission.keyboardHintLow: Keyboard: N or Esc denies; Y allows once
